description: Normal, stable walks of a person, copied from the other libraries: 26 styles chosen from the 438 two-legged person styles of those libraries that walk at 1.15 to 1.75 leg lengths a second (1.0 to 1.5 m/s on the person's 0.86 m legs). Each of the 438 was walked for 6 s on soma's person in the lab and measured, the best 130 were walked again for 8 s and measured with the worker's own frame clock, and a style is kept here when it reaches its own pace and never leaves the floor, steps alike with both legs, does not sink a sole into the floor or let a planted foot skate, does not lurch (the head's acceleration, sway and bob stay small, the bob at 4 cm or less), keeps the trunk upright and quiet, lifts the foot 5 to 15 cm, holds no prop, keeps both hands hanging by the hips (none held up) and swings the arms 10 to 55 cm. A style here is the library style of the same name without the 'normal_' in front, copied as it is (the numbers, the feet, the upper body). A creature takes one with legs: { gait: { from: name } }.
